                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"
                 body: "Reports: cr_1e2ea0 (2x, POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done), cr_ee551c (GET /v1/reminders/rem_0001). Version v1.4.0 (9c41e7a).\n\nCause: store/store.go (*Store).Get. For a tombstoned (deleted) reminder it sets r = nil but leaves err nil, so it returns (nil, nil). The doc comment says deleted reminders are not returned. api/reminders.go (*API).owned then reads rem.UserID at line 144 and dereferences nil. The logs show rem_0001 was deleted at 14:11:02, and the crashes followed at 14:12 and 14:15.\n\nFix: Get returns ErrNotFound for a deleted reminder. All other callers (api/lists.go, api/search.go, notify tests) already check err. Reproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound, which fails on the old code."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_comment
                 id: 101
                 body: "Root cause: auth/auth.go parseBearer. It checks only HasPrefix(h, \"Bearer\") and then indexes SplitN(h, \" \", 2)[1]. A header of exactly \"Bearer\" (no space and no token) gives a one-element slice, and [1] panics. Fix: require the \"Bearer \" prefix, trim the token, and reject an empty token. Reproducer: auth/parse_bearer_test.go TestParseBearerMalformed, which fails on the old code. All reports in fp_6b14b3 (cr_f9ee9e, 3x) have \"Authorization: Bearer\" with no token."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_comment
                 id: 102
                 body: "Root cause: notify/notify.go (*Dispatcher).Stop closes d.stop with no guard, so a second call to POST /v1/admin/dispatcher/stop panics. Fix: stopOnce sync.Once guards the close. Reproducer: notify/stop_twice_test.go TestStopTwice, which fails on the old code. Report cr_fd4982 (fp_2bcd17)."
  tool result: filed #103
  tool result: commented on #101
